per_step.command: mkdir -p /app/reports /app/logs; echo "=== Content files ==="; ls -la /app/content/; echo "=== analyze_content.sh ==="; cat /usr/local/bin/analyze_content.sh; echo "=== check_compliance.sh ==="; cat /usr/local/bin/check_compliance.sh; echo "=== audit log ==="; ls -la /app/logs/; echo "=== reports dir ==="; ls -la /app/reports/

REPORT="/app/reports/moderation_summary_$(date +%Y%m%d).json"
echo "Processing started at $(date)" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
rm -f $REPORT
echo "[]" > $REPORT
for file in $(ls /app/content/*.txt 2>/dev/null | sort); do
  echo "Analyzing $file" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
  result=$(/usr/local/bin/analyze_content.sh "$file")
  echo "Result for $file: $result" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
  jq --arg r "$result" '. += [$r]' $REPORT > /tmp/tmp$$.json && mv /tmp/tmp$$.json $REPORT
done
echo "Report generated:"
cat $REPORT
echo "Compliance score: $(/usr/local/bin/check_compliance.sh)"
echo "Processing completed at $(date)" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
ls -la /app/reports/
cat /app/logs/audit_trail.log
